notes: 1. Max. Trailer Weight Rating represents a properly equipped base trim configuration.
2. Vehicles with a GVWR of 13,500 and greater are DRW Vehicles less than 13,500 GVWR are SRW.
3. Payload and Max Trailer Weights are ESTIMATED values.
4. All values are shown in pounds unless otherwise stated.
5. Payload and Max Trailer Weight values are rounded to the nearest 10lb.
6. Payload = GVWR – Base Weight
7. Payload and Trailer Weight Rating are mutually exclusive.
8. GAWRs, GVWRs and GCWRs should never be exceeded.
9. Trailer Weight Rating and Tow Vehicle Trailering Weight are calculated as specified in SAE J2807.
10. Passenger Weight = 300 lb.
11. Options Weight = 100 lb.
12. Trailering Equipment Weight: 75 lb for Conventional Hitch, 70 lb for Gooseneck and 250 lb for 5th Wheel.
13. Tongue weight: 10 percent of the gross trailer weight for Conventional Hitch, 15 percent of the gross trailer weight for a 5th Wheel or
14. Payload and GAWR should never be exceeded and must account for all the above weights, including the appropriate trailering equipment
15. Box Off Body Completion Weight = 80 lb per foot from end of cab to end of frame
16. A fifth-wheel hitch is required for trailers over 23,000 lbs.
17. A Gooseneck hitch is required for trailers over 30,000 lbs.
